title: Network topology rendered from infrastructure as code
description: Per release, a machine-generated description of networks, zones, routes, security groups and private endpoints derived from the IaC state, with tenant cell mapping.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Network policy-as-code check results
description: Pass or fail results of rules such as 'no public address on data tier', 'ingress only 443', 'no route between prod and non-prod', for each IaC change.
producer: Praxis CI workflow (candidate; not operated for a production service)
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: External attack surface scan
description: Scheduled and post-deployment external scan of all registered hostnames and Echelon IP ranges, compared to the declared ingress register.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Egress allowlist register and denied egress log
description: Allowlist entries with owner, integration and justification, plus continuous log of denied egress attempts and alert dispositions.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Edge, WAF and DDoS configuration and event records
description: Exported edge configuration (rules, mode, rate limits) and WAF/DDoS event logs with alert dispositions.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Administrative session records
description: For each production access: requester, approver, sponsor pre-approval where required, scope, start, expiry, MFA method, device posture and recording reference; break-glass activations with both activators.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Domain and DNS configuration snapshot
description: Daily snapshot of registrar lock status, DNSSEC status, CAA records, zone contents and dangling-record check results.
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Flow log coverage and delivery heartbeat
description: Daily report that every production network has flow logs enabled and delivered, with gaps raised as control exceptions (SOC2-027).
signing: proposed: signed with a KMS-held evidence signing key (see ECTL-ENC-013); not implemented
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Independent network and application penetration test
description: External penetration test covering the internet-facing perimeter, ingress, remote access paths and tenant isolation. The Standard states external penetration testing remains planned.
retention: to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)
